Construct Docker Command Arguments for ODM

Source: R/ngr_spk_odm.R
ngr_spk_odm.Rd

Moved to spacehakr::spk_odm(). This wrapper forwards its arguments unchanged and will be removed in a future release — call spacehakr::spk_odm() directly.

Usage

ngr_spk_odm(...)

Arguments

...

Passed unchanged to spacehakr::spk_odm(), which owns the argument list and its defaults.

Value

The value of spacehakr::spk_odm().

See also

spacehakr::spk_odm()
